key_features: Infused with 0.1% retinal, the advanced form of retinol, combined with A-Shot, designed to directly penetrate pores and enhance absorption, delivers retinal deep into the skin to target wrinkles and enlarged pores, promoting smoother and firmer skin with advanced retinoid technology. Gentler and less irritating than tretinoin, while delivering powerful results.
Innovative skin care product with high-strength retinal and matrixyl 3000 that addresses skin concerns such as wrinkles, uneven texture and enlarged pores for a complete anti aging skin care routine.

A refined micro-particle ingredient, 16 times thinner than pores, is designed to penetrate directly into pores and enhance the absorption of active ingredients. Through high-purity separation and refinement, the particles are uniformly sized, reducing skin irritation and focusing on pores and skin texture. Infused with high concentrations of retinal, a more advanced form than retinol, and MATRIXYL, just a single drop provides deep elasticity to troubled areas such as wrinkles or enlarged pores while complementing your skin serum routine.

If irritation occurs, reduce the amount and frequency, and use a moisturizer containing soothing ingredients. The retinal may cause your skin to appear slightly yellow after application. It will wash off completely with cleansing.
